payload.description_html: The image shows a comparison between a Liopleurodon (at the bottom), a Megalodon (in the middle), a Livyatan (at the top), an orca, a great white shark, and, finally, a human being. Personally, I have always been fascinated by the great marine beasts of the past, and seeing how insignificant we are compared to these other animals really struck me—just imagine what would happen if these creatures were still alive today.
